\chapter{Programs — Basic}
%%% generated by the blueprint pipeline from TCSlib.Programs.WordRAM.Basic
\section{Overview}

Declarations of the Lean module \texttt{TCSlib.Programs.WordRAM.Basic}.

\section{Declarations}

\begin{definition}[Word RAM instructions]
\lean{WordRAM.Instr}
\label{WordRAM.Instr}
\leanok
A word RAM instruction is one of the following: write $1$ to register $i$; write the
sum, difference, or product of the words in registers $j$ and $k$ to register $i$; load
into register $i$ the word stored at the address held in register $j$; store the word in
register $j$ at the address held in register $i$; jump to program position $l$ if
register $i$ contains a negative integer; accept; or reject. Register indices are
integers and jump targets are natural numbers.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[Word RAM execution]
\lean{WordRAM.exec}
\label{WordRAM.exec}
\leanok
\uses{WordRAM.Instr}
For a word width $W$, a program $P$ consisting of word RAM instructions, a fuel amount
$t$, a program counter $pc$, and a memory assigning a $W$-bit word to each integer
address, execution returns either no result or a Boolean outcome together with the
resulting memory. With zero fuel it returns no result. With positive fuel it executes
the instruction at $pc$, treating a position beyond the program as a rejection:
arithmetic and memory operations update the designated cell and continue at the next
position, a conditional jump changes the next position according to whether the tested
word represents a negative integer, and acceptance or rejection returns the
corresponding outcome with memory unchanged.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[Loading integer words]
\lean{WordRAM.loadWords}
\label{WordRAM.loadWords}
\leanok
For a natural-number word width $W$ and a finite list of integers $w_0,w_1,\ldots$, the
memory obtained by loading the list assigns zero to every negative address. At a
nonnegative address $a$, it assigns the $W$-bit representation of the $a$th list entry,
using zero when the list has no such entry.
\end{definition}
